milestones.claim: Runtime scope and command boundary are explicit for local PINN claim admissibility.
milestones.doneMeans: CLI help and policy expose local-only commands and reject production/authority/PDE-correctness overclaims.

milestones.claim: Claim and evidence schema bind PINN claims to current subject identity.
milestones.doneMeans: Complete evidence passes while missing, stale, or mismatched hashes block with stable reason codes.

milestones.claim: Verifier adapter pack records deterministic pass/fail receipts.
milestones.doneMeans: All adapter families are checked and malformed, failing, wrong-hash, or stale receipts fail closed.

milestones.claim: Gate transition engine prevents unsupported claim advancement.
milestones.doneMeans: Complete paths advance, repairable gaps return repair/degrade, unsafe mismatches stop, and weaker arms cannot upgrade claims.

milestones.claim: Benchmark harness compares self-report, checklist, verifier-only, and full Proof-or-Stop arms.
milestones.doneMeans: Benchmark reports A1-A4 metrics, Wilson intervals, and A4 rejects every B1-B15 unsupported/stale injection.

milestones.claim: Reporting and governance integration render deterministic boundary-aware results.
milestones.doneMeans: Report command emits artifact index and boundary paragraph without claiming PDE correctness, production readiness, or external authority completion.
